subject.title: refactor(config): retire legacy flat streaming keys to doctor-owned migration

question: Should the released flat-aware `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-streaming` helpers remain available as a deprecated external compatibility seam while bundled runtime paths switch to nested-only helpers?
rationale: The latest release includes and tests flat fallback behavior, while repository policy treats shipped plugin SDK APIs as compatibility contracts; choosing to break that API requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve deprecated SDK compatibility
options.body: Keep external flat-aware helpers temporarily, add nested-only helpers for bundled runtime callers, and document a coordinated removal plan.

options.title: Approve immediate SDK breakage
options.body: Remove flat fallback behavior now and explicitly accept the external plugin upgrade impact with release guidance and compatibility evidence.

recommendation.title: Preserve deprecated SDK compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep external flat-aware helpers temporarily, add nested-only helpers for bundled runtime callers, and document a coordinated removal plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The shipped helper behavior and its tests appear to originate in this person's merged streaming normalization work.
